description: A CONSOLE RUN: chief drives `claude -p` through map -> synthesize -> plan -> gauntlet <-> revise -> final (and optionally execute) over one or more repos, billed to a Claude Console organization's API credits, every phase a file you can read, correct and rerun. Design: docs/explanation/console-runs.md; prompts: templates/console/. Chief stays a thin layer: it owns prompts, budgets, the run record, sequencing and gates; inside a phase Claude Code manages its own agents and worktrees. Execute mode hands tasklists to chief's existing machinery (chief gen; merging stays with chief run and the operator).

userStories.title: `chief console --dry-run` prints every phase's prompt and flags and spawns nothing
userStories.description: The command surface and template filling, with no model call.
acceptanceCriteria: `bin/chief console <repo>... --brief <file> --dry-run` fills each template under templates/console/ (every {{NAME}} from the README's table) and prints, per phase, the exact `claude -p` command line (model, --allowedTools or --permission-mode, --max-budget-usd, --json-schema where used) without starting claude.
A template left with an unfilled `{{` makes the command exit non-zero naming the placeholder (test/console-dry-run.sh).
README's command table and docs/reference list the command; the docs gate passes.

userStories.title: The credential never reaches a shell environment
userStories.description: Billing to the Console organization without exporting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
acceptanceCriteria: With `--account console`, chief sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (default ~/.chief/claude-console) or `--settings` with an apiKeyHelper only on the claude processes it starts; `chief console --check` reports which account is active without printing any secret.
A test proves the parent shell's environment is unchanged after a run and that no *_API_KEY variable is set in chief's own process (test/console-credential.sh).

userStories.title: Plan mode runs end to end on a fixture repo with a stub claude
userStories.description: The phases, the run record and resumption, without spending credits.
acceptanceCriteria: Against a fixture repo and a stub `claude` on PATH that answers each phase from canned files, `chief console --mode plan` writes .chief/console/<run>/ with brief.md, run.json, map/*.md, architecture.md, plan.md, roadmap.json, critic/<lens>-r<n>.json, decisions.md, final/ and cost.json.
The gauntlet loop stops when every lens returns pass with no blocker or major, or at --rounds; verdicts failing the critic JSON schema are rejected and retried once.

`--from gauntlet` reuses earlier files and `--to map` stops after the mappers; `--rerun map:<subsystem>` redoes one mapper; `--lens-file` adds a brief's own critic lens; a phase whose budget would push the total over --budget is not started and the run says so.

userStories.title: Final output generates valid tasklists
userStories.description: The plan becomes chief work through the existing generator.
acceptanceCriteria: final/roadmap.json passes `chief gen -n` (schema-valid tasklists, NDJSON); a fixture roadmap that fails is reported with the failing items.

userStories.title: Execute mode runs one tasklist as builder <-> critic rounds and never merges
userStories.description: Building through claude -p in a worktree, bounded like the loops.
acceptanceCriteria: `--mode execute --tasklist NN` runs builder then critic rounds (stop: zero blocker and major, at most 5 rounds) with the builder in its own worktree (`claude -p --worktree`, acceptEdits plus the scoped tool list) and the critic read-only with fresh context; with the stub claude a fixture tasklist reaches pass in round 2.
Heavy commands are wrapped by `--lock <cmd>` when given; no base branch is ever written (asserted in the test); the branch is left for `chief run`'s merge phase.

userStories.title: Spend is recorded and reported
userStories.description: Cost per phase from claude's JSON output, visible in chief usage.
acceptanceCriteria: cost.json records phase, model, session id, usd and tokens per call from `--output-format json`; `chief usage` includes console runs; a run's total never exceeds --budget in the stub test.
